summary: Today's pick in America: buy NVDA. Today's pick in India: wait for now (if buying anyway, their favourite is ). Analysts are talking about whether to buy shares of Nykaa or Honasa Consumer in India with the practice money, noting that festive season excitement might help but costs and taxes mean the stock needs to go up a lot to make a big profit. They also discuss that with only one hundred dollars in the US, it is not possible to buy a whole share of a new company's stock, and even buying part of a share of Nvidia would not grow enough to reach a ten times return in a year.
